notes.title: Spooky Night Remastered
notes.notes:
Hey Everybody!
Grimelda is still at it but with some new tricks and treats in store! Spooky Night Remastered is a Casual Fantasy FPS for the whole family We have overhauled and updated the original Spooky Night VR game and also made it available for the Oculus Quest. Its Halloween night and your walking past a cemetery when you notice a pot of sweet delicious candy. Suddenly, out of nowhere a voice appears, It's the witch Grimelda! She has trapped you inside her cemetery. you must survive and fight your way out. Defeat her minions and keep the candy, but should you lose you will become one of her minions forever! Fight your way through 7 challenging levels as you defeat, Skeletons, Zombies,Mummy's,Werewolf's, Orcs, and Dragons. Don't forget to collect hidden treats (CANDY) and unlock tricks hidden inside the zones along the way.

[h1][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1178060/Spooky_Night_2/]WISH LIST HERE[/url][/h1]
[b]The Witch Grimelda is still at it![/b] Stealing children and growing her monster minion army. In this sequel you will be taken back to the first place you encountered Grimelda , prepared and equipped with your homemade weapons you confront her. Amused by your challenge she dares you to attempt to defeat her. You must free captured children along the way, and are sent on a fun spooky magical adventure before your final battle. 

Completely revamped visuals, game-play and jam packed with multiple spacious levels, new characters, new monsters, new weapons and new objectives! (Mini Boss Fights)  ( 4 weapons ) ( 13 Enemies ) Fun for the whole family [b]RPG ADVENTURE[/b] game.
